{{Top|leg}}
'''Pseudo-skin''' was a type of makeup which looked like real skin when applied to the body, and when done properly would be firmly attached to their body. This was often used to cover up signs of injuries, or scar damage. It could also be used to hide signs of aging.

[[Lumiya]] used it after her [[Duel on Roqoo Depot|duel]] with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] on [[Roqoo Depot]].
